sample_method: first 100000 complete CSV records from bounded compressed prefix; not representative of whole catalog
selection: Curated familiar title/artist examples present in sampled first 100000 canonical rows; fill remaining slots by ascending public canonical priority. At most four recordings per artist; deduplicate title plus artist ID; skip malformed/composite credits and bracketed non-song labels. Curated membership never changes search ranking, which uses public canonical priority only.
